verdict.rationale: Headless or dedicated-server execution is a fair axis for a game engine, so the story applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents running PlayCanvas game logic on a server without rendering. The pack shows only a browser-targeted engine (WebGL2/WebGPU), a standalone npm engine package, and physics components, none of which establish a headless server runtime.

support.subject: As a game developer, game logic runs headless on servers — a dedicated-server or server-runtime build without rendering
